metadata.question: On August 2, 2018, did the water temperature at Long Beach (33.601421, -118.089042) show a higher temperature anomaly, when compared to the long-term average for this time of year, than that observed at Pismo Beach (35.128348, -120.727924)?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: NOAA CDR Sea-Surface Temperature (SST, “NOAA/CDR/SST_PATHFINDER/V53”) – daily 4 km. - Date 2018-08-02 for the single-day anomaly. - Long-term average: same calendar day (02-Aug) over the 30-year climatology band supplied in the same collection (“sst_clim_summer” or “sst_clim_annual”); we’ll use “sst_clim” (multi-year mean for the day-of-year) if available; otherwise we compute the mean of 02-Aug SST for 1983-2012 (30 yr). - Locations: – Long Beach: 33.601421, -118.089042 – Pismo Beach: 35.128348, -120.727924 2. Masking: - Use the “quality_level” band ≥ 3 (good/acceptable pixels). - Water-only via the collection’s built-in land mask. 3. Logic to avoid C3: - Confirm 2018-08-02 image exists. - Confirm climatology image exists and yields a finite mean. - Ensure at least 1 valid pixel inside a small buffer around each point; otherwise C2. - Compute anomaly = SST_2018 – SST_clim for each site. - Compare the two anomalies; if Long Beach anomaly > Pismo Beach anomaly → A, else B. - If any required value is None/NaN → C3. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & day-of-year ptLB = ee.Geometry.Point([-118.089042, 33.601421]) ptPB = ee.Geometry.Point([-120.727924, 35.128348]) doy = ee.Date('2018-08-02').getRelative('day', 'year') # 2. Acquire data sst = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/CDR/SST_PATHFINDER/V53') \ .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2018, 2018, 'year')) \ .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(8, 8, 'month')) \ .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2, 2, 'day_of_month')) if sst.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No 2018-08-02 image.") print("C1") exit() # Climatology (1983-2012, same day-of-year) clim = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/CDR/SST_PATHFINDER/V53') \ .filterDate('1983-01-01', '2013-01-01') \ .filter(ee.Filter.dayOfYear(doy, doy)) if clim.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No climatology images.") print("C1") exit() # 3. Quality mask & extract def good(img): q = img.select('quality_level') return img.updateMask(q.gte(3)) sstImg = good(sst.first()) climImg = good(clim.mean()) def getSST(img, pt): scale = 4000 v = img.select('sea_surface_temperature') \ .subtract(273.15) \ .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=pt.buffer(5000), scale=scale, maxPixels=1e9).get('sea_surface_temperature') return ee.Number(v) sstLB = getSST(sstImg, ptLB).getInfo() sstPB = getSST(sstImg, ptPB).getInfo() climLB = getSST(climImg, ptLB).getInfo() climPB = getSST(climImg, ptPB).getInfo() if None in [sstLB, sstPB, climLB, climPB]: print("Missing temperature values.") print("C3") exit() anomLB = sstLB - climLB anomPB = sstPB - climPB print(f"2018 SST: LB {sstLB:.2f} °C, PB {sstPB:.2f} °C") print(f"Clim: LB {climLB:.2f} °C, PB {climPB:.2f} °C") print(f"Anomaly: LB {anomLB:.2f} °C, PB {anomPB:.2f} °C") if anomLB > anomPB: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & day-of-year
ptLB = ee.Geometry.Point([-118.089042, 33.601421])
ptPB = ee.Geometry.Point([-120.727924, 35.128348])
doy = ee.Date('2018-08-02').getRelative('day', 'year')

# 2. Acquire data
sst = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/CDR/SST_PATHFINDER/V53') \
        .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2018, 2018, 'year')) \
        .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(8, 8, 'month')) \
        .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2, 2, 'day_of_month'))
if sst.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No 2018-08-02 image.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# Climatology (1983-2012, same day-of-year)
clim = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/CDR/SST_PATHFINDER/V53') \
         .filterDate('1983-01-01', '2013-01-01') \
         .filter(ee.Filter.dayOfYear(doy, doy))
if clim.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No climatology images.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# 3. Quality mask & extract
def good(img):
    q = img.select('quality_level')
    return img.updateMask(q.gte(3))

sstImg  = good(sst.first())
climImg = good(clim.mean())

def getSST(img, pt):
    scale = 4000
    v = img.select('sea_surface_temperature') \
           .subtract(273.15) \
           .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                         geometry=pt.buffer(5000),
                         scale=scale,
                         maxPixels=1e9).get('sea_surface_temperature')
    return ee.Number(v)

sstLB  = getSST(sstImg, ptLB).getInfo()
sstPB  = getSST(sstImg, ptPB).getInfo()
climLB = getSST(climImg, ptLB).getInfo()
climPB = getSST(climImg, ptPB).getInfo()

if None in [sstLB, sstPB, climLB, climPB]:
    print("Missing temperature values.")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    exit()

anomLB = sstLB - climLB
anomPB = sstPB - climPB
print(f"2018 SST: LB {sstLB:.2f} °C, PB {sstPB:.2f} °C")
print(f"Clim:     LB {climLB:.2f} °C, PB {climPB:.2f} °C")
print(f"Anomaly:  LB {anomLB:.2f} °C, PB {anomPB:.2f} °C")

if anomLB > anomPB:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
